title: SOURCE FIRST scientific workflow policy
scope: promotion of a diagnostic to theorem/gate authority

search_targets: alternative terminology and structurally equivalent formulations
source_check.freshness_rule: If the question depends on current/fresh literature, search the web again even if an earlier source audit covered the same broad topic.

source_verdict_firewalls.NOT_LOCATED_IN_THIS_SEARCH: Never promote to a novelty claim.
source_verdict_firewalls.KNOWN_AND_IMPORTABLE: Import exact statement/hypotheses/source authority; do not rebuild a redundant gate.
source_verdict_firewalls.KNOWN_BUT_HYPOTHESES_DIFFER: Record exact mismatch before any internal theorem/gate.
source_verdict_firewalls.CONTRADICTS_CANDIDATE: Stop candidate promotion; resolve the contradiction first.

domain_mismatch_rule.statement: External theorem implications must match the exact domain before import.
domain_mismatch_rule.example: Generic #P-completeness of counting antichains in arbitrary posets does not imply #P-completeness of counting exact-channel representations without a realization/reduction theorem for the exact-channel SCC-poset family.

confirmation_bias_firewall.statement: Source audit must search for falsifiers/stronger results/negative results and not only confirmation.

gate_firewall.rule: No new scientific preregistration or execution gate may be frozen until the step-specific source audit is complete.

audit_targets: existing graph decomposition/recognition theorems relevant to exact-channel patterns
known recognition algorithms that may subsume PASS/FAIL patterns
R1_policy.after_audit_only: Freeze the authoritative C11 residual corpus and preregister the corpus-wide v1.6 exact-channel survey.

baseline_relation.R0: Baseline source map / continuing watch, not permission to skip future source checks.
baseline_relation.current_exact_channel_theorems: Remain internally proved graph theorems unless/until external literature subsumes them.

canonical_motto: SOURCE FIRST -> FORMALIZE -> PREREGISTER -> EXECUTE -> REPLAY -> SEAL
